cluster_summary: This cluster comprises vulnerabilities where size or length fields from untrusted binary input are used to allocate memory or control operations without adequate validation. Common flaws include missing upper bounds, integer overflow in arithmetic, invalid back-reference offsets, and improper handling of edge cases, leading to memory exhaustion, data leaks, or denial of service.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the guard is enforced before the sensitive effect and remains bound to the same resource, principal, destination, or object that the effect uses. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Change the counting predicate from (b > 0) to (b != -1) to include all non-EOF bytes..

mechanism.name: Off-by-one in byte counting ignores zero-value bytes
mechanism.sink_shape: the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs
mechanism.typical_fix: Change the counting predicate from (b > 0) to (b != -1) to include all non-EOF bytes.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Change the counting predicate from (b > 0) to (b != -1) to include all non-EOF bytes.
sub_patterns.name: Off-by-one in byte counting ignores zero-value bytes
sub_patterns.root_cause: Resource limit counter increments only on positive read returns, incorrectly excluding null bytes (value 0) from the count.
